1.title: Phase 1/10 — Core Playable Foundation, Lore Prologue & Intuitive UI
1.focus: Create the game folder, manifest (`"phase": "1"`), responsive Canvas + ResizeObserver harness, unified InputManager (Keyboard/Mouse + Touch), baseline SaveManager + SoundEngine, a polished Title Screen featuring a Lore Prologue + 3-Panel `How to Play` Guide (`Goal & Lore` | `How It Works & Why` | `Desktop & Touch Controls`) + smooth Options Modal (`Audio & Comfort` | `Controls` | collapsible `<details>` `Manage Save Data`), `window.ARCADE_CARTRIDGE_META` synergy descriptor, and a 100% playable core gameplay loop implementing the Genre x Twist mechanic with setting-authentic palette (never generic dark neon circles).

2.title: Phase 2/10 — Player Mastery, Secondary Tactical/Creative Tool & Expressive Rig
2.focus: Deepen player control, tool ergonomics, and visual expression (`player.js` or expanded protagonist/tool subsystem): add a secondary tactical ability, styling tool, or overdrive action with HUD indicator, multi-part procedural character/station/vehicle rig with expressive animations (recoil, garment layering, portrait expressions, or tool feedback), and responsive input tuning. Set `"phase": "2"` in `game.json`.

3.title: Phase 3/10 — Rich Setting Diorama, Multi-Layer Backdrop & Interactive Stage Elements
3.focus: Bring the Axis C visual setting to life (`world.js` or environment/studio subsystem): implement at least 3 layered setting backdrops using the archetype's curated color palette (sunlit, pastel, parchment, felt, or comic noir—not plain black), plus interactive stage elements (runway lighting, kitchen stations, city districts, destructible fortress timber, or environmental hazards). Set `"phase": "3"` in `game.json`.

4.title: Phase 4/10 — Diverse Roster of 5 Challenges, Clients, Rivals or Enemy Archetypes
4.focus: Expand gameplay variety (`enemies.js` or roster/client subsystem) to at least 5 distinct genre-appropriate archetypes (e.g. 5 Runway Judges/Client Briefs, 5 Romanceable Leads/Rivals, 5 Diner Party/Critic Types, 5 Fortress/Lane Unit Classes, or 5 Construct Enemies), each with distinct visual silhouettes, clear telegraphs/preferences, and unique behaviors. Set `"phase": "4"` in `game.json`.

5.title: Phase 5/10 — Milestone Showdowns, Boss Encounters & Grand Finale Events
5.focus: Implement multi-phase Milestone Showdowns (`bosses.js` or event subsystem) triggered at key progression milestones (e.g. Fashion Week Gala Finale, Friday Critic Rush, Festival Confession, District Kingpin Takeover, Barrier Wall Breakthrough, or Boss Wave): create at least 2 distinct Showdowns with progress/HP banners, phase shifts, and bespoke challenges testing the Axis B twist. Set `"phase": "5"` in `game.json`.

6.title: Phase 6/10 — Deep Progression, Workshop/Boutique Shop, Perk Draft & Combo Multipliers
6.focus: Add compelling between-round/in-run progression (`progression.js` or shop/upgrade subsystem): implement a genre-authentic Upgrade Shop, Boutique Wardrobe Unlock, Venue Upgrade Catalog, or 3-Card Perk Draft (4-6 meaningful upgrades), 1 interactive bonus pickup/swatch/charm, and a visible Synergy/Combo multiplier indicator. Set `"phase": "6"` in `game.json`.

7.title: Phase 7/10 — High-Impact Tactile Juice, Particle Emitters & Expressive Feedback
7.focus: Add high-signal visual feedback (`vfx.js` or juice subsystem): implement directional particle bursts/sparkles on actions, satisfying reveal/hit transitions, screen-shake or camera pulse respecting reduced-motion settings, and floating score/affection/tip/style popups. Set `"phase": "7"` in `game.json`. CRITICAL: In addition to defining `addShake`, `burst`, and `addFloatingText` in `vfx.js` and calling `this.vfx.update(dt)` / `this.vfx.draw(ctx)` in `game.js`, you MUST invoke `this.vfx.addShake(...)`, `this.vfx.burst(...)`, and `this.vfx.addFloatingText(...)` at actual gameplay event call-sites inside `game.js` (scoring, collisions, phase transitions, game over), or internal code review will fail.

8.title: Phase 8/10 — Multi-Voice Web Audio Synthesizer & Genre-Authentic Adaptive Soundtrack
8.focus: Upgrade `SoundEngine` (`audio.js` or audio subsystem) into a procedural Web Audio synthesizer: add a melodic/percussive loop styled to the genre (cozy cafe jazz, runway synth-pop, medieval war-drums, or arcade pulse) that adapts during Milestone Showdowns or high-combo states, plus 5+ synthesized SFX across core actions, UI, and upgrades. Set `"phase": "8"` in `game.json`.

9.title: Phase 9/10 — Smooth Tabbed Options UI, 3-Panel Instructions, Touch Ergonomics & Milestones
9.focus: Perfect the User Interface, accessibility, and persistence (`ui.js` or UI subsystem): ensure a smooth, logical Options Modal (`Audio & Comfort` with Mute/Volume/Reduced-Motion/High-Contrast | `Controls` with Left/Right Touch Handedness | collapsible `<details>` `Manage Save Data` for Base64 Export/Import/Reset), clear 3-Panel `How to Play` guide with Lore, and 4-6 unlockable Milestones. Set `"phase": "9"` in `game.json`.

10.title: Phase 10/10 — Full UI/Asset Synergy, Balance Polish & Acceptance Evidence
10.focus: Perform final integration and UI/Cabinet synergy verification (`endgame.js` or endgame/synergy subsystem): verify `window.ARCADE_CARTRIDGE_META` exposes accurate lore, palette, instructions, and scene descriptors to the Arcade Home; add a concise Round 1 contextual goal banner and victory/mastery summary; and set `"phase": "10"` in `game.json`.
